# @zakkster/lite-inp

Zero-GC INP attribution via Event Timing API + Long Animation Frames.

## What it does

Observes PerformanceEventTiming entries (interactions) and
PerformanceLongAnimationFrameTiming entries (LoAF) using PerformanceObserver.
Writes to preallocated typed-array ring buffers -- zero heap allocation
per event in the observer callback.

Computes INP (Interaction to Next Paint) as the p98 worst interaction
duration, with phase breakdown (input delay, processing time, presentation
delay) and LoAF script attribution (invoker, sourceURL, sourceFunctionName).

## API

createInpObserver(options?) -- start observing.
  options: interactionCap, loafCap, durationThreshold, onUpdate.

obs.getINP() -- current INP entry with attribution (cold path, allocates).
obs.getINPInto(target) -- fill a caller-owned entry with the current INP,
  zero alloc; returns true/false; attribution is null. getINP() stays the
  ergonomic allocating form.
obs.getInteractions() -- all interactions sorted by duration.
obs.getLoafs() -- recent LoAF entries with scripts.
obs.destroy() -- disconnect observers, remove listeners, reset state.
obs.inp -- the actual p98 INP duration (number, O(1) no alloc; null when
  no interaction recorded). Equals getINP()?.duration -- both recompute the
  same page-lifetime skip live on every read.
obs.worstDuration -- the worst (max) interaction duration (number, no alloc).
obs.currentINP -- DEPRECATED alias of worstDuration (the max, NOT the p98
  INP). Use obs.inp for the INP.
obs.supported / obs.loafSupported -- feature detection.

onUpdate(entry) fires on the hot path when a new worst is recorded
(entry.newWorst) OR the p98 INP candidate changes (entry.inpChanged); the
entry is reused, attribution is null.

Lifecycle: a bfcache restore (pageshow with event.persisted) resets INP for
the new page view; a prerender activationStart offset is applied to reported
startTimes. Both handled internally, zero config.

## Zero-GC design

Observer callbacks write to Float64Array/Int32Array SoA columns.
Event types interned to integer IDs. Map<interactionId, slot> is the
only per-interaction allocation (user-initiated, not per-frame).

onUpdate reuses a single entry object. Attribution is null on the hot
path (populating it means walking the LoAF ring and allocating a scripts
array) -- call getINP() from inside onUpdate or on any cadence you
prefer if you need attribution for the current INP. This split is
deliberate: measuring INP should not itself cause GC pauses that
perturb what you are measuring.

## Browser support

Event Timing (interactionId): Chrome 96+, Firefox 144+.
LoAF (script attribution): Chrome 123+.
Feature-detected; graceful degradation.
